workItem: VAI-01 — build a read-only repository artifact version inventory for all git-tracked files.
workItemDE: VAI-01 — read-only Repository-Artifact-Version-Inventar fuer alle git-getrackten Dateien aufbauen.
projectStage: PVC-06 Version Management; supporting PVC-04 Supervisor and PVC-07 Release Management
priorityReason: Same-version structural drift in PR-template consumers is not represented by the current platform-version authority alone.
scopeBoundary: package.json#version remains the sole platform-version authority.
No platform SemVer is assigned to every repository file.
No VersionManager control plane is created or revived.
No Self-Healing controller, merge authority, provider mutation or direct-main mutation is added.
VAI-01 is read-only classification and fingerprint evidence only; consumer-graph and Self-Healing integration remain separate follow-up slices.
acceptanceCriteria: Every git index stage-0 tracked path is classified into exactly one approved artifact domain.
The inventory is deterministic for an unchanged Git index and changes when a tracked blob changes.
A PR-template body structure change with the same 1.8.0 declaration changes blob and inventory identity.
package.json remains the only PLATFORM_VERSION_AUTHORITY path.
Inventory generation performs no repository content rewrite.
releaseCondition: Release on Human/CODEOWNER merge, PR close, supersession or abandonment; no direct-main mutation.
